scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — colorblind-safe palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and a marginal box plot show real craft, but the percentile labels collide with the subtitle text and the top-earner callout label is clipped at the right edge.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for income data, no lie factor (uniform dot radius encodes position only), colorblind-safe palette, and box plot quartiles are correctly computed — main deduction is the hardcoded x-scale domain [14000, 550000] rather than data-driven d3.extent, which breaks the scaling metamorphic relation.
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static rendering (force simulation pre-computed with .stop()), no brush/zoom/transitions, and unified pointer events for tooltips — no interaction robustness violations detectable.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single view with 4-category Tol palette, 400 pre-computed swarm dots, and a summary box plot below — the color separation is clean, reference percentile lines add context without clutter, and the 5 top-earner callouts are readable despite slight crowding in the upper-right; the only friction is dot overlap in the dense center bulk, which is unavoidable at this n.

proposer: Removed unused `id` and `eduIdx` properties from data objects (-2 lines) and collapsed the clamping forEach to a single line (-2 lines). Total: 229 lines, no functional changes.
